components.name: Inquire Primary Button
components.description: Primary Cobalt CTA button with 4px radius used for Inquire, Start an Inquiry, and Send Inquiry.
components.css: .ds-btn-inquire { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-width: 148px; background-color: var(--accent, #2563EB); color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'PP Neue Montreal', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-inquire:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-inquire:active { transform: translateY(0.5px); } .ds-btn-inquire:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid var(--accent, #2563EB); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Surface Button
components.description: Soft hairline-bordered button over Paper/Graphite Elevated for Resume PDF download and modal controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-width: 148px; background-color: var(--bg-elevated, #F1EFEA); color: var(--text-primary, #141413); font-family: 'PP Neue Montreal', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(20, 20, 19, 0.08)); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #E7E4DD; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid var(--accent, #2563EB); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stack Tool Pill
components.description: Compact 4px-radius inline pill displaying a tool icon and name inside 03 — stack.
components.html: Figma

components.css: .ds-project-well { position: relative; padding: 24px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(20, 20, 19, 0.08)); background-color: var(--bg-elevated, #F1EFEA); background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(20, 20, 19, 0.065) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 12px 12px; font-family: 'PP Neue Montreal', sans-serif; } .ds-standin { position: absolute; top: 10px; right: 10px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--bg, #FAF8F5); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(20, 20, 19, 0.08)); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted, #706E69); } .ds-mockup-window { border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg, #FAF8F5); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(20, 20, 19, 0.08)); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -6px rgba(20, 20, 19, 0.10); overflow: hidden; } .ds-mockup-bar { display: flex; gap: 5px; padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(20, 20, 19, 0.08)); background: var(--bg-elevated, #F1EFEA); } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(20, 20, 19, 0.18); } .ds-mockup-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 16px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary, #585753); } .ds-mockup-body strong { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-primary, #141413); }

components.name: Editorial Form Input
components.description: Clean 4px-radius form input with soft elevated fill and Cobalt focus border.
components.css: .ds-input-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: 'PP Neue Montreal', sans-serif; } .ds-input-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-secondary, #585753); } .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 4px; background-color: var(--bg-elevated, #F1EFEA); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(20, 20, 19, 0.08)); padding: 10px 14px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-primary, #141413); transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted, #706E69); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #2563EB); }

narrative.northStar: The Tactical Optical Desk & Cartographic Ground
narrative.overview:
The portfolio of Jan Lloyd Cagoco (Product Designer & Associate Developer at LGU Baggao) is structured as a single unified editorial shell pairing a sticky left identity rail across a generous negative space gulf with an authored Baggao cartographic banner, tactile 3-card certification stack, and real municipal engineering records.

Every route (/, /projects, /experiences, /stack, /certifications, /projects/[slug], /inquiry) shares the exact same spatial frame: an unbordered left identity and navigation rail (210px wide) separated across a generous negative space gulf (lg:gap-28 xl:gap-36) from a focused reading column (max-w-[720px]). Horizontal top navigation bars and footer strips are completely discarded in favor of architectural quietness.
keyCharacteristics: Unbordered left sidebar with generous negative space separation (lg:gap-28 xl:gap-36).
Active navigation flanked by optical directional arrows (->Projects<-) using Hugeicons.
Custom brand cartography of LGU Baggao with downward gradient fade mask.
Tactile 3-card certification peek stack with Framer Motion spring physics.
Two first-class color themes (Soft Paper Light / Soft Graphite Dark) plus live OS System mode.
Zero decorative lines above buttons, zero eyebrows, zero filler microcopy.

rules.name: The First-Class Theme Rule
rules.body: Light and Dark modes are co-equal citizens. Every component binds to CSS tokens without color flashing or unstyled states.

rules.name: The Rarity of Cobalt Rule
rules.body: Cobalt accent is used on ≤5% of any screen. Its rarity makes it authoritative for active tabs, focus indicators, and verified links.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: All years, coordinates, lot numerals, and dates strictly enforce tabular numerals (fontFeature: 'tnum' 1 or tabular-nums) to preserve optical column alignments.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section headings and page headers stand on their own weight. No kicker or eyebrow text may precede a heading.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never carry heavy drop shadows at rest. Shadow is reserved strictly for layered card stacks and active floating states.

dos: Do maintain the unbordered left identity rail and generous whitespace gulf (lg:gap-28 xl:gap-36) across every route.
Do preserve the active navigation bracket syntax (->Projects<-) with Hugeicons ArrowRight01Icon and ArrowLeft01Icon.
Do use tabular numbers (tabular-nums) for all dates, coordinates, and metrics.
Do label synthetic placeholder visuals discreetly with SYNTHETIC.
Do support full keyboard navigation and prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add horizontal top navigation bars or bottom footer strips.
Don't add eyebrow or kicker labels above headings.
Don't add decorative lines or rules immediately above buttons.
Don't use gradient text or colored border-left accents.
Don't invent artificial employers, awards, or metrics.
